name: Orson Blythe
source_profile:
Orson Blythe (LN) — Town Reeve

Orson is the marquis's appointed municipal administrator and superintendent of Blackvein's royal claims registry. Formerly a clerk in the financial offices of northern Cador, he possesses considerable experience in property law, taxation, and commercial administration. His meticulous habits and formal manner have earned him little affection among Blackvein's rougher inhabitants, although few question his competence.

Orson enjoys the confidence of Aldric Voss, who values his ability to impose order upon the chaotic mining economy. He believes that reliable property records and enforceable contracts are indispensable to the town's prosperity, and regards the old camp's informal claims system as hopelessly inadequate.

His greatest difficulty concerns the legitimacy of mining rights established before the creation of the marquisate. Borin Blackpick has repeatedly presented him with ancestral dwarven deeds, while Cinderhook merchants and Karrathi representatives have challenged concessions issued over territory they regard as their own. Orson is not indifferent to these grievances, but believes he lacks the authority to recognize claims outside the legal framework established by the crown.

His relationship with Gable Sorn is similarly complicated. Orson considers Ironmark an essential institution for the town's commercial development, but has grown uncomfortable with the frequency with which indebted prospectors lose their claims to the company's creditors. He suspects that the law is being exploited, though he remains reluctant to challenge transactions that appear formally legitimate.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 91 (source excerpt; may be partial)
